AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 19, 2026
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

Katie Larson, Chair  Ryan Gales, Commissioner
Mark Christoffels, Vice Chair  Mireya LaFarga, Commissioner
Phyllis Arias, Commissioner  Marva Thomas, Commissioner
Kenneth Brown, Commissioner  Randy Zarn, Commissioner

  AGENDA

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to

  lgbarpt@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54159  Recommendation to approve the minutes from the Airport Advisory Commission
  meeting on January 15, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54160  Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding the LGB Business
  Partner Spotlight, featuring Giovanna Martinelli with Paradies Lagardère.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54258  Recommendation to consider the content of the Airport Advisory Commission 2025
  Annual Report and take action to refer it to the City Council.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54400  Recommendation to receive and file report from the Sustainability Committee,
  regarding Airport sustainability efforts with air quality, energy conservation, water
  quality, and waste management.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54161  Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding the first annual
  recognitions for the Long Beach Airport Fly Friendly Program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 19, 2026
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

6.  26-54162  Receive and file Monthly Airport Staff Reports for February and March 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Airport Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Ken Mason, Executive Assistant, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to
the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Long Beach Airport at (562) 570-2619 or
LGBarpt@longbeach.gov.
